title: Why Ashwini Vaishnaw is Worst Rail Minister?
description:
While Ashwini Vaishnaw is busy launching new trains and giving interviews, the Indian Railways is quietly falling apart. Trains are crashing. Platforms are overcrowded. Staff are overworked. Passengers are fed inedible food. But PR campaigns roll on, as if nothing’s wrong.

In this video, we break down why Ashwini Vaishnaw is one of the most failed Rail Ministers in recent times. From serious safety lapses to mismanagement and cosmetic announcements, we expose the gap between glossy headlines and grim ground reality.

Indian Railways doesn’t need photo-ops. It needs leadership.
